diagnosis.summary: USB lamp circuit board with red and black wires detached. Stripped copper ends are visible beside + and - solder pads. Suspected loose contacts, electrical cause not proven.
likely_causes: Detached solder joints at + and - pads due to pull strain
Suspected open connection, not confirmed electrically

decision.reasoning: USB-powered lamp board with both red and black leads detached at the marked + and - pads. No battery reported. Pads look present and suitable for re-soldering after a power-free continuity check, so a conditional self-repair is reasonable.

shopping_list.name: Soldering iron 25-40W with fine tip and stand
shopping_list.search_term: soldering iron 30W fine tip electronics with stand

shopping_list.name: Lead-free solder wire 0.5-0.8 mm for electronics
Heat shrink tubing assortment for low voltage

steps.title: Disconnect all power and confirm no battery
steps.text: Unplug USB completely and place board on wood table. Visually confirm: no battery, no rechargeable pack, no mains cable. Confirm device is only powered by the USB plug shown. Do not continue if any battery or unknown power source is present. End state: board fully disconnected and power-free.
steps.common_mistake: Assuming unplugged means safe without checking for battery or mains - stop if any other power source is found.

steps.title: Test wire assignment power-free
steps.text: With power still disconnected, inspect markings: left pad marked + and right pad marked -. Set multimeter to continuity mode. Check each wire end to end for continuity while gently wiggling, without applying voltage. Check there is no short between + and - pads. Only continue if red lead belongs to + side and black lead to - side and pads are intact. If polarity unclear, pads damaged, or short suspected, stop and seek professional help. End state: wire-to-pad assignment confirmed power-free.
steps.common_mistake: Mixing up red and black by color alone - always verify + and - markings and continuity.

steps.title: Fix board and prepare wires
steps.text: Fix board in helping hands with + and - pads facing up. Slide one piece of heat-shrink tubing onto each wire away from heat and park it. Gently twist frayed copper strands of each stripped end into a neat point. Apply a tiny amount of electronics flux to pads and wire tips. End state: board stable, wires prepared, tubing parked.
steps.common_mistake: Twisted frayed strands left splayed cause shorts - re-twist neatly and keep insulation clear of pad.

steps.title: Solder red wire to + pad
steps.text: Solder red wire to + pad: hold twisted red copper end on + pad. Touch fine soldering iron tip to both pad and wire together for 2-3 seconds, feed a little solder to the joint, then remove solder then iron. Hold still until cool. Work ventilated, place iron in heatproof stand, do not touch tip, do not inhale fumes. End state: shiny wetted joint with no loose strands.
steps.common_mistake: Heating too long lifts the pad - heat 2-3 seconds only, then remove iron and let cool.

steps.title: Solder black wire to - pad
steps.text: Solder black wire to - pad: hold twisted black copper end on - pad. Touch fine iron tip to both pad and wire for 2-3 seconds, feed a little solder, then remove solder then iron. Let cool undisturbed. Use heatproof stand and ventilation as before. End state: firm wetted joint on - pad with no bridges to neighbor.
steps.common_mistake: Swapping wires creates reverse polarity - keep black only on - pad.

steps.title: Check, insulate and brief function test
steps.text: When cold and still unplugged, tug gently to check mechanical hold. Check with multimeter continuity and no short between + and -. Slide heat-shrink over exposed joints only if it can fully cover without heating nearby parts, then shrink per maker instructions. Close housing, then brief function test at intended USB low-voltage source. If heat, smell, or malfunction occurs, unplug immediately and seek professional help. End state: insulated, closed, tested or safely aborted.
steps.common_mistake: Testing with damaged insulation or open housing risks short - insulate and close housing first.
